# Brian Ruggieri

> Full-stack engineer and creative technologist based in Athens, GA. I build interactive platforms, data tools, and immersive experiences — from web apps to real-time 3D.

roojerry.com is the personal portfolio of Brian Ruggieri ("roojerry" is his personal brand/handle). The site is fully server-rendered; interactive WebGL/canvas experiments require JavaScript and are not visible to fetch-only agents.
